scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../editor build && tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --clean --sourcemap && tsup src/cli.ts src/server-entry.ts --format esm --dts --sourcemap --external @vue/compiler-sfc --external postcss --external postcss-scss && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts --format esm,cjs --dts --clean --sourcemap --watch ../server/src src --onSuccess "tsup src/cli.ts src/server-entry.ts --format esm --dts --sourcemap --external @vue/compiler-sfc --external postcss --external postcss-scss && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs"
